title: Elements Playground Architecture
description: Implement the new Elements architecture: keep @elements/lib/react/core as pure React components with no classes, keep @elements/lib/framework/core as pure TypeScript classes with no React, make @elements/lib/framework/renderer/react the first renderer for framework core, finish @elements/lib/playground, and update @elements/lib/react/spatial/play to use the new playground. Fix the current Nx duplicate project configuration blocking @elements/geometry-spatial-play:dev.
